name: Eltharion the Grim
canonNotes: Warden of Tor Yvresse, blinded in battle and bound to the city's waystone to keep its magic in balance.
Grim and sorrowful; once a dashing prince, now duty itself.
voiceNotes: Austere, sombre and unbending; speaks of sacrifice and duty.
Little warmth; ruthless toward Greenskins and Druchii.
sources: Total War: WARHAMMER III, in-game unit lore (summarised, not quoted)
